headline: Transport strike withdrawn in 5 districts of Khulna and Barisal divisions
summary: The transport strike affecting five districts across Khulna and Barisal divisions has been called off, bringing an end to disruptions for commuters and businesses.
details: A transport strike that had been affecting five districts in Bangladesh's Khulna and Barisal divisions has officially been withdrawn. The decision brings an end to the disruption of public transportation services in these regions.

The strike had impacted daily commutes and goods movement, causing inconvenience for residents and businesses. With its withdrawal, normal operations are expected to resume shortly, restoring connectivity.
caption:
Good news for commuters! The transport strike in 5 districts of Khulna and Barisal divisions has been called off.

A transport strike that had been affecting five districts in Bangladesh's Khulna and Barisal divisions has officially been withdrawn. The decision brings an end to the disruption of public transportation services in these regions.

The strike had impacted daily commutes and goods movement, causing inconvenience for residents and businesses. With its withdrawal, normal operations are expected to resume shortly, restoring connectivity.

headline: Miscreants set fire to 'July Memorial' in Noakhali
summary: The 'July Memorial' in Noakhali was reportedly set on fire by miscreants. This act of vandalism has been reported in the district.
details: Unidentified miscreants reportedly set fire to the 'July Memorial' in Noakhali. The incident, which constitutes an act of vandalism, has caused damage to the monument.
caption:
The 'July Memorial' in Noakhali has been set ablaze by miscreants.

Unidentified miscreants reportedly set fire to the 'July Memorial' in Noakhali. The incident, which constitutes an act of vandalism, has caused damage to the monument.
